title: Hidden Cypress | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Private Pool Just Steps from Beach- Hidden Cypress by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Hidden Cypress by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 115 Cypress Grove Ln Details: Hidden Cypress is an upscale, grand and luxurious beach home located in the heart of Seagrove Beach on a very quiet street tucked among the Cypress Grove. With the seclusion of the State Park to the north and the ease of several beach accesses, Hidden Cypress is a short walk or bike ride to the sugar-white sand. This single level home has a large living/dining area with a beautiful shell gas fireplace, a large HDTV, classic high-end beach décor and a large farm table with seating for 10. The gourmet kitchen is a Chef's dream and encompasses a large marble island with bar seating for 3 and every imaginable kitchen tool to make memorable meals. The private (heated) pool and fire bowl, surrounded by Adirondack chairs, are the highlight of the fenced outdoor living space. A gas grill, outdoor dining table and screened porch makes this backyard oasis as much fun as being on the beach. Enjoy the wide front porch with comfortable rockers and a peaceful view of the Cypress Grove. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 8-Minute Walk (0.4 miles) -Parking Spaces: 3 -Dining Accommodations: Table for 10, Bar Seating for 3 and an Outdoor Table for 6 -Coffee Bar With Standard Coffee Maker And Keurig, Complimentary Coffee and Coffee Filters -Screened in Outdoor Porch Area -Propane Grill -Outdoor Shower -Short Walk to The Beach -Private Heated Pool: 8’ x 11’ *Pool can be heated Sep - Apr for an additional charge of $305 (plus tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 4 beds / 3.5 baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Shared Jack and Jill Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 3: (2) Twin Beds with Shared Jack and Jill Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) - Extra Sleeping Space: Loft Room above Bedroom 2 with Two Twin Bunk Beds -Additional Sleeping: Twin/Twin Bunks in a Loft above Bedroom #2 -Kitchen / Dining Room / Living Area / Laundry Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
